title: The First Deep Learning all-sky List of Fermi-LAT Gamma-ray Sources
summary: The U-Net/DNN pipeline produces a 3,800+ source Fermi-LAT all-sky catalog; the paper reports a few additional sources subsequently confirmed in FL16Y, a concrete astronomy result enabled by learned detection and characterization.
ai_technology: U-Net segmentation plus DNN source localization, flux estimation and genuine/spurious classification produce the source list.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Pipeline is assessed on simulations with known truth, tested against interstellar-emission-model variation, compared to 4FGL-DR2, and the cited follow-up list confirms a few new sources. No independent claim beyond those reported.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: U-Net segmentation plus DNN source localization, flux estimation and genuine/spurious classification produce the source list.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
